bio.text: Dominique Johnson has represented Connecticut's 143rd House District since 2023 and is the Democratic candidate for the seat on the November 3, 2026 ballot.

She earned a B.A. in communication studies from Bryn Mawr College in 1999, an M.A. in communication from Stanford University in 2003 and a Ph.D. in urban education policy from Temple University in 2009.
Her career includes work as a nonprofit consultant, a college professor and a researcher.
